chunks: Among them: meaning by it other people.
ai.seo_question: Who does Imam Ali refer to as 'them' in Sermon 8 of Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this concise clarification from Sermon 8, Imam Ali (AS) disambiguates the pronoun 'them' to specifically identify the hypocrites (Munafiqun) who coexisted with the pure Household of the Prophet (Ahl al-Bayt) during the transitional period of the Age of Ignorance. This distinction is crucial in Shia exegesis for understanding the political and spiritual dynamics of early Islam, highlighting the contrast between the steadfastness of the Ahl al-Bayt and the duplicity of the hypocritical faction.
